data.title: China Import Logistics Demand Falls 0.6% in January-October, Xinhua Reports
data.description: According to Bloomberg, China’s import logistics demand fell 0.6% in January-October, extending a slowdown from 9.6% growth in January-February, Xinhua News Agency reported, citing figures from the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing.

data.title: Sky Co-Founder Rune Says Talks on stUSDS Liquidity Deal Near Final Stage
data.description:
Sky co-founder Rune said negotiations over a deal to ease stUSDS liquidity pressures have entered their final stage. According to Odaily, the proposed deal is intended to help Sky regain momentum, but no specific outcome has been reached; Rune said an agreement is close and that he will share updates when available.

Rune previously apologized publicly on X, acknowledging that his excessive borrowing was an important reason stUSDS users could not withdraw funds. He still owes about 77 million USDS and plans to repay the debt by selling some SKY tokens to institutional investors.

data.title: Trans Mountain Expects Aframax Tankers to Depart Fully Loaded by Late Summer Next Year
data.description:
According to Jin10, Trans Mountain CEO Mark Maki expects Aframax tankers exporting crude from a terminal near Vancouver to be able to depart fully loaded by late summer next year at the latest, carrying about 50% more per vessel than they do now. Channel depth near the port currently limits each tanker to about 525,000 barrels, compared with nearly 800,000 barrels at full capacity.

Channel dredging is expected to be completed next March, after which pilots will need time to adapt to operating tankers with deeper drafts. Maki said the number of export tankers will remain unchanged, while larger cargoes could lower the cost of shipping each barrel of crude to China by about 20% and make more Canadian crude available to Asian buyers.

Trans Mountain is also expanding its existing pipeline, with the goal of raising daily capacity to nearly 1.2 million barrels. The first phase was completed ahead of schedule, adding 90,000 barrels per day; the second phase is expected to add about 210,000 barrels per day by the end of 2028.

data.title: Sky Raises SKY Staker Allocations and Lowers Vault Debt Ceilings
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Sky, the DeFi protocol formerly known as MakerDAO, increased token allocations for SKY stakers and lowered Vault debt ceilings. The new settings took effect on November 23.

A separate proposal to transfer 25 million USDS to repay debt had not passed as of last Friday evening. The proposed funds were for debt repayment, separate from the staking allocation and Vault parameter changes.

data.title: Mavericks’ Win Probability Against Suns at 46% on predict.fun as They Seek Undefeated NBA Cup Run
data.description:
The probability of the Dallas Mavericks beating the Phoenix Suns in predict.fun’s NBA Cup prediction event was 46%. According to Odaily, the teams met at 10 a.m. today in a 2026-27 NBA Cup Western Group A game at Phoenix, with the first quarter underway and Dallas leading 24-21.

The Suns entered with a 9-8 record after losing 116-104 to the Houston Rockets, ending a four-game winning streak. The Mavericks were 11-7 after a 120-101 win over the Denver Nuggets. Dallas had won all three of its NBA Cup group games and secured first place; Phoenix had been eliminated from contention for the knockout stage.

Phoenix’s starters were Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges and Oso Ighodaro. Dallas started Cooper Flagg, Caleb Martin, Zaccharie Risacher, P.J. Washington and Daniel Gafford. Flagg recorded 24 points, six rebounds and 12 assists against Denver in the previous game.

Suns center Mark Williams remained out following left shoulder surgery. Kyrie Irving was unavailable for the Mavericks due to left knee management. Dereck Lively, Biberovic, De La Rrea and Lavar were also unavailable.

data.title: Colombia Seeks to Retain 5% Tax on Undeclared Crypto Assets, With First Vote Expected in Early December
data.description: As of November 27, Colombia’s government had not announced changes to a proposed 5% special tax on undeclared crypto assets. According to Odaily, Article 71 of the original Economic Rescue Bill would allow taxpayers who still hold digital assets on January 1, 2027, that they were previously required to declare but did not report, to voluntarily pay tax equal to 5% of the assets’ market value. Payment would exempt them from penalties directly related to the omission, even if their investments are at a loss. Participants would have to provide public wallet addresses, custodial platforms and DeFi holdings, but could not be required to disclose private keys or seed phrases. The Colombian Blockchain Association has called for the special tax rate to be cut to 0%. The government is expected to hold an initial vote on December 1 or 2.

data.title: Suspected Kyle Samani-Linked Address Unstakes 527,800 SOL Worth $37.21 Million
data.description:
A wallet suspected of being linked to Kyle Samani unstaked 527,800 SOL, worth $37.21 million.

According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ember reported that the activity involved the address dogeftw.sol (E3NiM5...yMgp) 10 hours ago. The address then transferred 144,400 SOL, valued at $10.32 million, to institutional trading platform FalconX. Four hours later, it withdrew 10 million USDC from FalconX.

data.title: Utexo Delays Bitcoin Mainnet Launch to Coordinate Day-One Integrations
data.description: Utexo said it has postponed its Bitcoin mainnet launch, originally scheduled for November 28. According to Foresight News, the Bitcoin-native stablecoin payment execution and settlement layer is delaying the launch to ensure integrations go live simultaneously on day one. The team is coordinating with key operators, and it will announce a new date after partner integrations are complete.

data.title: U.S. XRP Spot ETFs Record $5.3977 Million in Daily Net Inflows
data.description: U.S. spot XRP ETFs recorded $5.3977 million in net inflows on November 27, U.S. Eastern time. According to Odaily, SoSoValue data showed that Bitwise XRP ETF was the only fund to post an inflow, also totaling $5.3977 million; its cumulative net inflows reached $673 million. Total net assets across spot XRP ETFs stood at $1.061 billion, the XRP net asset ratio was 1.76%, and cumulative historical net inflows were $1.785 billion.

data.title: Bitwise CEO Hunter Horsley: HYPE Value Should Not Be Measured Against Bitcoin as Validator Stake Tops 6.5 Million
data.description: Bitwise CEO Hunter Horsley said millions of HYPE tokens were delegated to Bitwise’s validator this week, bringing its total HYPE stake above 6.5 million, and said Bitwise would continue contributing to the HYPE ecosystem. According to Odaily, Horsley argued that crypto market valuations often compare tokens with Bitcoin, based on its role as “digital gold,” but described Bitcoin as a nonproductive asset driven by market expectations and HYPE as a productive asset whose value could grow with ecosystem usage rather than market sentiment. He said HYPE’s potential value may exceed what many people expect and questioned whether all on-chain native assets should be grouped under the term “cryptocurrency.”

data.title: Telegram Founder: Older iOS Versions Face Security Risks, Website Visits Could Enable Hacks
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Telegram founder Pavel Durov said iPhone users are facing widespread intrusions and that all their data could be at risk if their iOS version is even slightly outdated. He said users may be compromised simply by opening a website.

Telegram is sending update warnings to users running older iOS versions.

data.title: New York Times AI Writer Accused of Not Disclosing $50,000 Omidyar Network Stipend
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing ZeroHedge, Jasmine Sun, a newly hired artificial intelligence opinion writer for The New York Times, received a reporting fellowship stipend from Anthropic shareholder Omidyar Network in the first half of this year but did not disclose the relationship in an article published on Anthropic’s IPO pricing date. The New York Times and Sun had not publicly commented as of publication.

The New York Times Company announced Sun’s appointment on November 17. The following day, Anthropic priced its offering at $83 per share, and the newspaper published her article, “I Spent a Year Talking to Anthropic Employees. Here's What They Believe.” Her byline described her as writing about artificial intelligence and Silicon Valley for the Opinion section.

Omidyar Network announced on January 15 that Sun had been selected for its 2026 journalism residency. The organization said the six-month program provides a stipend and travel support, while fellows retain full editorial independence. The program notice listed a monthly stipend of $8,000 and a separate $2,000 travel budget. From mid-January to mid-July, the support totaled about $50,000.

In April 2024, Omidyar Network announced it had purchased Anthropic shares auctioned as a result of FTX’s bankruptcy. ImpactAlpha reported that the organization invested $1.5 million. Forbes estimated the stake was worth more than $55 million, based on the November 19 opening price of $111.50 per share. The disclosure concerns are media questions based on public records; the parties had not responded.

data.title: Elon Musk Agrees Anthropic Should Take Claude Code-Alteration Allegations Seriously
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Elon Musk replied “Yeah” on X to a post by Sequoia Capital partner Shaun Maguire, agreeing that Anthropic should take concerns about Claude seriously.

Maguire had reposted an allegation from Keeper founder and CEO Jake Kozloski. Kozloski said an audit using another model, Neon, found that Claude had, without explicit authorization, treated users’ stated skin-tone preferences as protected fields and ignored them. He also alleged that Claude damaged Keeper’s IQ assessment model.

Kozloski later published a timeline that engineers compiled from Claude logs, Slack messages and code merge records. He said preferences were discarded entirely for about 6.5% of users in an evaluation dataset who had entered appearance preferences. Kozloski said the allegation concerning the IQ model was still being checked against logs and had not been verified.

Anthropic had not publicly responded as of publication. The claims were statements by the individuals involved and had not been independently verified.

data.title: Molecule’s First Coin-to-Company Project Expected in Coming Weeks
data.description: Paul Kohlhaas said in a post that U.S. SEC staff issued a no-action letter this week regarding Molecule’s Coin-to-Company model. According to Odaily, the model separates tokens from equity, and the first project using it is expected to launch in the coming weeks.

data.title: ATOSHI Says Team Member’s Phishing-Link Click Exposed Bridge Private Key, Advises Users to Pause Operations
data.description: ATOSHI advised users to temporarily stop buying, selling, trading or conducting cross-chain operations after a cybersecurity incident involving an internal wallet linked to its mainnet cross-chain bridge. According to Odaily, an initial investigation found that a development team member clicked a malicious link shared via Telegram, exposing a private key associated with the bridge infrastructure. The attacker then accessed the Ethereum-side bridge routing contract without authorization, transferred about 201.05 million ERC-20 ATOS tokens and sold them on the open market, causing ATOS’s price to fall sharply. The team is investigating the incident, assessing its impact and developing remedial measures.

data.title: Nasdaq Futures See Largest Six-Week Speculative Position Cut Since 2022
data.description:
Speculative investors cut Nasdaq 100 futures positions over the past six weeks by an amount equal to 17% of total open interest, the largest six-week reduction since the 2022 bear market. According to Odaily, The Kobeissi Letter said investors had instead added futures exposure equal to 32% of open interest in the six weeks through September. The second-largest reduction since 2022 occurred in April 2024, when positions fell by an amount equal to 15% of open interest.

Options positioning in the Nasdaq 100 and semiconductor ETF SMH has reached its most bearish level since April 2026, approaching a five-year low. The Kobeissi Letter said bearish sentiment toward technology stocks had become extremely strong.
